description: The constructed value satisfies \(a_n=h(n,C([a_0,\ldots,a_{n-1}]))\), using the empty history at \(n=0\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FiniteSequenceCoding.history_equation (h : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FiniteSequenceCoding.historyValue h n =
    h n
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FiniteSequenceCoding.code
        (List.map (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FiniteSequenceCoding.historyValue h) (List.range n)))
